_comment: Single source of truth for every number quoted in pgw/docs. kind: measured (observed in a run), analytic (computed exactly from model shapes and ring size), derived (arithmetic on measured numbers), estimate (assumption-based; must be labelled 'estimate' wherever it is quoted). 'display' is the exact text used in the documents; tests/docs checks that every entry is quoted and that estimates are labelled.

sources.otp-masks: Kaggle kernel kaggle/onprem_otp/run.py, log results/kaggle/onprem-otp-masks (Tesla T4, 4 vCPU), 2026-11-16
sources.otp-cost: Kaggle kernel kaggle/onprem_otp_cost/run.py, log results/kaggle/onprem-otp-cost (Tesla T4, 4 vCPU Xeon 2.0 GHz avx512f, no VNNI), 2026-11-16
sources.factory-box: pgw.factory cpu_int8 benchmark on the 4-core development container (INTERFACE_NOTES.md, 2026-11-17)
sources.spec: pgw/SPEC.md and the shapes of the public model configs
sources.pricing: Public cloud list prices used in otp-cost (AWS g4dn.xlarge on-demand, approximate T4 spot)
sources.hemask-k32: Encrypted mask generation on Kaggle (Tesla T4 provider, 4 vCPU AMX gateway), benchmarks/results/kaggle/run11_k32, see docs/operations/encrypted-masks.md
sources.modal-2026-11-20: Two-party Modal deployment (deploy/modal, STATUS.md update of 2026-11-20): encrypted mask supply over the public Modal tunnel
